caption: Each edge goes one way, so it fills one cell and joins one list

steps.caption: Edge 0 1: matrix[0][1] becomes 1 and 1 joins the list of 0. Nothing changes for 1
Edge 1 2: matrix[1][2] becomes 1 and 2 joins the list of 1. Nothing changes for 2
Edge 2 3: matrix[2][3] becomes 1 and 3 joins the list of 2. Nothing changes for 3
Edge 3 0: matrix[3][0] becomes 1 and 0 joins the list of 3. Nothing changes for 0
That's the graph with the arrows from earlier, with its list and its matrix
